clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Elaine Carevin sends aid to Sven Yorgen's camp in northwestern Duskwood. Sven and his few followers struggle against the dangers of the blighted woods.

Sven Yorgen and a few companions keep a camp on Duskwood's northwestern frontier. Darkshire faces wolves, spiders, and restless dead, yet Sven's band holds its ground beyond the town's walls. Constant danger leaves them unable to spare anyone for the perilous journey back to town for provisions. Elaine Carevin arranges for travelers to carry supplies so the fighters can keep going.

The Carevin family respects Sven and sees his stand as devotion to the Light. Elaine organizes and sends supplies to support his camp. When Sven receives the crate, he recognizes the Carevins' support, though his attention remains on the battle at hand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.
Unfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look a sturdy type, adventurer. Have you come to join our fight?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These supplies will be most useful. The aid of the Carevin family is always appreciated. Here is a little something for your trouble.
